tools.name: find_toilets_near
tools.title: Find public toilets near a place
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for the nearest public toilet, or for toilets near a street, station or town. Returns up to 20 toilets sorted by distance, with walk time, access rule, fee, open now, closing time, wheelchair access and a map link. Do not use it for toilet products or plumbing.

place.description: Street, station, landmark or town from the user message, for example Darmstadt Hauptbahnhof.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Narrows the place lookup.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84. Send with lon, if you already know the coordinates.

open_now.description: Drop toilets that are closed now. Toilets with unknown hours stay and show open_now unknown.

changing_table.description: Only toilets with a changing table.

free.description: Only toilets known to be free of charge.

no_purchase_needed.description: Only toilets that need no purchase.

annotations.title: Find public toilets near a place

tools.name: get_toilet
tools.title: Get one public toilet
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one toilet from an earlier answer: hours, access rule, fee, last confirmation. Needs the id from find_toilets_near.

prompts.name: nearest_toilet
prompts.title: Find the nearest public toilet
prompts.description: Find public toilets near a place and say which one to use.

arguments.name: needs
arguments.description: Comma separated: wheelchair, changing_table, free, no_purchase_needed.
